summary: This specification validates the centralized backup framework for RDS and DynamoDB resources across a multi-tenant AWS environment. It focuses on policy enforcement, cross-account data isolation, and adherence to RPO/retention targets.

glossary.definition: Service Control Policy used for organization-wide guardrails.
Customer Master Key used in AWS KMS for encryption.
Recovery Point Objective - the maximum acceptable amount of data loss.

test_approach: The testing strategy combines manual inspection of AWS configurations (SCPs, Vault Policies) with automated verification of backup/restore workflows. Security testing prioritizes negative scenarios to ensure tenant isolation, while performance testing validates SLA compliance for data replication and RPO.

dependencies.description: Access to the Management Account to verify policy propagation and delegated admin settings.
A test AWS account containing RDS and DynamoDB resources to verify backup/restore.

risks: Inability to test cross-region copy if the secondary region is not accessible in the test environment.
Testing SCP 'Deny' rules requires high-level access that may be restricted in non-production environments.

preconditions: AWS Backup Plan deployed to Tenant Workload Account.
RDS instance present with appropriate tags.
acceptance_criteria: Backup plan successfully targets the tagged RDS instance.
test_cases.description: Verify that AWS Backup correctly identifies and backs up RDS resources in a tenant account based on defined policies.
test_cases.expected_result: A recovery point is created in the local vault for the targeted RDS instance within the scheduled window.
steps: 1. Manually trigger the 'DailyBackup' plan in the Tenant Workload Account.
2. Monitor the 'Backup jobs' console in the AWS Backup dashboard.
3. Verify the creation of a snapshot in the local vault.

test_cases.description: Verify that local backups are automatically copied to the central vault in the Dedicated Backup Account.
preconditions: Cross-account copy configuration active between Tenant and Dedicated accounts.
Successful local backup exists in Tenant account.
steps: 1. Identify a successful local backup job in the Tenant account.
2. Wait for the automated copy job to trigger.
3. Log into the Dedicated Backup Account and check the central vault for the new recovery point.
test_cases.test_data: Copy Job Latency Target: 4 hours (Hard Max)
test_cases.expected_result: Recovery point is visible in the central vault within 4 hours of local backup completion, measured as a HARD MAXIMUM.
acceptance_criteria: Snapshot appears in the Dedicated Backup Account vault.
Snapshot is encrypted with the Platform CMK.
Tenant DevOps role receives 'Access Denied' when attempting to delete a vault.
preconditions: SCP 'DenyDeleteBackup' applied to the Tenant's Organizational Unit.
User logged in with Tenant DevOps Engineer role.
test_cases.expected_result: The 'DeleteBackupVault' operation is blocked by an explicit Deny in the SCP.
steps: 1. Assume the Tenant DevOps Engineer role in a workload account.
2. Navigate to AWS Backup -> Backup vaults.
3. Select a vault and attempt to 'Delete'.
test_cases.description: Negative Test: Verify that SCPs prevent Tenant DevOps Engineers from deleting backup vaults.
Positive Test: Verify that a Platform Administrator can modify and deploy backup policies centrally.
steps: 1. Update the 'BackupPolicyJson' in the Management Account to change the start window.
2. Save and apply the policy to the target OU.
3. Verify the policy update in the Tenant account's AWS Backup console.
preconditions: User logged in with Platform Administrator permissions in the Management Account.
test_cases.expected_result: The updated policy is visible and active in the delegated admin account and member accounts.
acceptance_criteria: Platform Administrator can successfully update a Backup Policy in the Management account.

test_cases.expected_result: The time between consecutive successful recovery points is <= 12 hours, measured as a HARD MAXIMUM.
test_cases.description: Verify that the backup schedule meets the 12-hour Recovery Point Objective (RPO).
acceptance_criteria: Backup frequency is set to 12 hours or less.
Last backup age is within the RPO threshold.
steps: 1. Review the backup history for a production RDS instance.
2. Calculate the time difference between the completion of the last two successful backups.
preconditions: Backup plan active for at least 24 hours.

test_cases.expected_result: KMS cryptographic operations (Decrypt/DescribeKey) are denied for tenant identities.
test_cases.description: Negative Test: Verify that tenants cannot access or use the KMS CMKs in the Dedicated Backup Account.
preconditions: KMS Key Policy in Dedicated Account restricts access to platform roles only.
User logged in with Tenant DevOps role.
steps: 1. Attempt to describe the Platform KMS key using the Tenant DevOps role via CLI.
2. Attempt to decrypt a cross-account snapshot using the same role.
acceptance_criteria: Tenant role receives 'Access Denied' when attempting to use the Platform KMS key.

test_cases.description: Verify that failed backup copy jobs trigger appropriate alerts via EventBridge and SNS.
test_cases.expected_result: An alert notification is delivered to the SNS topic within 5 minutes of a job failure.
preconditions: EventBridge rule and SNS topic configured.
steps: 1. Simulate a failed copy job (e.g., by temporarily modifying vault permissions).
2. Monitor the SNS subscription (email/Slack) for the failure alert.
acceptance_criteria: EventBridge rule triggers on 'Copy Job State Change' to 'FAILED'.
SNS notification is received by the platform team.

test_cases.description: Verify cross-region replication of backups from the central vault to the DR vault.
preconditions: Cross-region copy enabled in the central backup plan.
steps: 1. Verify a successful backup exists in the Central Backup Vault.
2. Check the DR Backup Vault in the secondary region for the replicated snapshot.
acceptance_criteria: Snapshot is successfully copied to the DR vault in the secondary region.
test_cases.expected_result: A copy of the backup exists in the secondary region's DR vault.

test_environment: The test environment must be a multi-account AWS Organization with at least one Management account, one Dedicated Backup account, and two Tenant Workload accounts (Prod and Non-Prod). All primary resources must be deployed in the London (eu-west-2) region to match design constraints. Mock RDS and DynamoDB instances must be provisioned with standard datasets.
open_questions: Confirm if the 12-hour RPO is a 95th-percentile goal or a hard maximum for all resources.
Clarify if the 'Restore process' includes cross-region restoration from the DR vault or only local-region restoration.
name: Enterprise AWS Backup Framework Test Specification
